events.title: Justin I makes his nephew Justinian co-emperor
events.description: The ageing Justin I raised Justinian to co-emperor of the Eastern Roman Empire. Within months he ruled alone, and his reign would reconquer Italy, codify Roman law and raise the Hagia Sophia.
events.html: The ageing Justin I raised Justinian to co-emperor of the Eastern Roman Empire. Within months he ruled alone, and his reign would reconquer Italy, codify Roman law and raise the Hagia Sophia.

events.title: Alexios Komnenos seizes Constantinople from Nikephoros III
events.description: After bribing the Western troops guarding the city, Isaac and Alexios Komnenos entered the capital, overthrowing Nikephoros III Botaneiates. Alexios was crowned on 4 April after his troops had looted Constantinople for three days.
events.html: After bribing the Western troops guarding the city, Isaac and Alexios Komnenos entered the capital, overthrowing Nikephoros III Botaneiates. Alexios was crowned on 4 April after his troops had looted Constantinople for three days.

events.title: Sea Beggars capture Brielle from Spain
events.description: Dutch rebel privateers known as the Sea Beggars seized the port of Brielle. It was the revolt's first secure foothold on land and set off a wave of risings across Holland and Zeeland against Spanish rule.
events.html: Dutch rebel privateers known as the Sea Beggars seized the port of Brielle. It was the revolt's first secure foothold on land and set off a wave of risings across Holland and Zeeland against Spanish rule.

events.title: The US House of Representatives meets for the first time
events.description: Less than a month after the Constitution took effect, the House convened in New York City, then the nation's capital, and elected Frederick Muhlenberg of Pennsylvania as its first speaker. Under the Great Compromise, its seats were divided by population.

events.title: Sheridan breaks the Confederate line at Five Forks
events.description: Union troops under Philip Sheridan routed Confederates at Five Forks, Virginia, cutting Lee's last supply railway into Petersburg. Lee abandoned Petersburg and Richmond the next day.
events.html: Union troops under Philip Sheridan routed Confederates at Five Forks, Virginia, cutting Lee's last supply railway into Petersburg. Lee abandoned Petersburg and Richmond the next day.

events.title: Royal Air Force formed as the first independent air force
events.description: Britain merged the Royal Flying Corps and the Royal Naval Air Service into the Royal Air Force, the world's first air arm independent of army and navy control.
events.html: Britain merged the Royal Flying Corps and the Royal Naval Air Service into the Royal Air Force, the world's first air arm independent of army and navy control.

events.title: Munich court sentences Hitler to five years for the Beer Hall Putsch
events.description: Adolf Hitler received five years' detention for his failed coup of November 1923. He served barely nine months at Landsberg, where he dictated Mein Kampf.
events.html: Adolf Hitler received five years' detention for his failed coup of November 1923. He served barely nine months at Landsberg, where he dictated Mein Kampf.

events.title: Nazi regime stages a nationwide boycott of Jewish businesses
events.description: SA men stood outside Jewish-owned shops, offices and surgeries across Germany to turn customers away. The one-day boycott was the first nationally coordinated anti-Jewish action of the new regime.
events.html: SA men stood outside Jewish-owned shops, offices and surgeries across Germany to turn customers away. The one-day boycott was the first nationally coordinated anti-Jewish action of the new regime.

events.title: Franco declares the Spanish Civil War over
events.description: With the last Republican forces surrendered, Francisco Franco announced the end of the war. His victory began a dictatorship that would last until his death in 1975.
events.html: With the last Republican forces surrendered, Francisco Franco announced the end of the war. His victory began a dictatorship that would last until his death in 1975.

events.title: US forces land on Okinawa
events.description: American troops came ashore on Okinawa in Operation Iceberg, the largest amphibious assault of the Pacific War. The 82-day battle that followed cost the lives of well over 100,000 soldiers and civilians.
events.html: American troops came ashore on Okinawa in Operation Iceberg, the largest amphibious assault of the Pacific War. The 82-day battle that followed cost the lives of well over 100,000 soldiers and civilians.

events.title: Jobs, Wozniak and Wayne found Apple Computer
events.description: Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak and Ronald Wayne signed the partnership that created Apple Computer in California. Its first product was the hand-built Apple I; Wayne sold his share within days.

song: Iranians; Iranian movements for constitutional government and freedom
A Persian song from the 1920s about a caged bird at dawn. Iranians have sung it for a hundred years to ask for freedom.
